title: Siege of Maastricht (1579)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Maastricht (1579)", at revision 1382267592, opens: "The siege of Maastricht was a battle of the Eighty Years' War which lasted from March 12 to July 1, 1579. The Spanish were victorious." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2758693, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege and capture of Maastricht by Alexander Farnese during the Eighty Years' War (1568-1648)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
